nodes.speaker: Elder Heron
nodes.text: The fog has swallowed our lantern's light. Will you help us, traveler?

nodes.speaker: Elder Heron
nodes.text: A goblin raiding party slipped in at dusk. Without the lantern, the fog will choke the crops.

choices.text: Then I have no time to waste.

nodes.speaker: Elder Heron
nodes.text: Thank you. Search the town square for clues. I'll mark what we know on your map.
